svg.title: Briefing
svg.desc: I build AI-first products: systems where agents, workflows and APIs are part of the architecture from the first commit, not a chatbot added later. Most of my open-source work is the harness that lets agents operate real systems safely. Operating principles: APIs instead of screenshots; Workflows instead of one-off prompts; Typed SDKs instead of fragile scripts; Repeatable processes, not chaotic sessions. Loadout: TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, MCP, n8n, Claude Code.
